episodes.synopsis: A naive young woman named Nao is dragged into the Liar Game and seeks the assistance of a notorious conman.
episodes.title: The Legendary Con Artist

episodes.synopsis: Nao and Akiyama crank up the pressure to try to retrieve Nao's millions.
episodes.title: Shockwave

episodes.synopsis: The first round of the Liar Game reaches its end and a new round begins.
episodes.title: Resolution

episodes.synopsis: Nao frets over her chance of survival as the rules of the Minority Rule game are explained.
episodes.title: Minority Rule

episodes.synopsis: Akiyama and Nao proceed further into the Minority Rule game with their alliance strategy.
episodes.title: Alliance

episodes.synopsis: With the player known as X revealed, the Minority Rule game enters a terrifying new stage.
episodes.title: Initiative

episodes.synopsis: The Minority Rule comes to its shocking conclusion, and Nao seeks a way to get back into the game.
episodes.title: The Losers' Revival

episodes.synopsis: Leronira explains what this game will entail, and the players begin making their first plans.
episodes.title: Downsizing Game

episodes.synopsis: Nao makes a desperate ploy to climb out from the depths of despair.
episodes.title: Light and Darkness

episodes.synopsis: The other Revival Round players scramble for the votes to save themselves.
episodes.title: Salvation

episodes.synopsis: Leronira introduces the surviving players to the complex rules of the Contraband Game.
episodes.title: Contraband Game

episodes.synopsis: The game begins, and both teams lay out the strategies they will follow in the opening rounds.
episodes.title: Yokoya

episodes.synopsis: Kikuzawa tests his surefire method for detecting contraband, while Akiyama and Nao try to figure out Yokoya.
episodes.title: Fissures

episodes.synopsis: The Country of Day team corners Kikuzawa to make him reveal how he knew Yokoya before entering the game.
episodes.title: Dictatorship

episodes.synopsis: Akiyama comes up with a plan to compensate for the Country of Day's weaknesses, but Yokoya also makes a move.
episodes.title: Secret Plan

episodes.synopsis: Akiyama concocts a new plan to pull his team out of a hopeless situation.
episodes.title: Turbulence

episodes.synopsis: The curtain is pulled back on the Country of Night and the system of control used by Yokoya.
episodes.title: Tip-off

episodes.synopsis: Yokoya learns of Akiyama's plot and begins his counter-strategy.
episodes.title: Caution

episodes.synopsis: The Contraband Game reaches its climax and the final standings are revealed.
episodes.title: Solidarity

episodes.synopsis: After the smuggling game ends, it is time to see how much money each player has earned.
episodes.title: Provocation

episodes.synopsis: The rules for the Spearhead Match are explained and Fukunaga comes strong out of the gate.
episodes.title: Spearhead Match

episodes.synopsis: Nao notices a contradiction in the Spearhead Match incentives.
episodes.title: Trap

episodes.synopsis: The rules of Seventeen Poker are explained and appear to give Akiyama's opponent an advantage.
episodes.title: Core Match

episodes.synopsis: Kikuchi uses his natural advantage to get the upper hand on Akiyama.
episodes.title: Counterattack

episodes.synopsis: The result of the Core Match is revealed, and the final game's rules are explained.
episodes.title: General Match
